craft_claim: Adult playfulness is a measurable disposition whose OLIW model includes a distinct 'whimsical' facet, so appetite for a whimsical register varies across readers and argues for bounded rather than continuous deployment.

supporting_evidence.note: Proyer develops the Short Measure of Adult Playfulness (SMAP), showing a one-dimensional solution with good internal consistency and test-retest reliability, and locating playfulness with cheerfulness and culture and against low seriousness.
The review describes the OLIW model of adult playfulness with four facets - Other-directed, Lighthearted, Intellectual, and Whimsical - giving a named psychological home to the 'whimsical' facet.

scope: Audience disposition and dosage planning; not a claim about prose technique.
exceptions: Trait playfulness describes receivers, so it cannot license a universal dosage rule; individual pieces must still be judged on effect.
